---
id: gray-wolf
title: Gray wolf
---
The gray wolf (*Canis lupus*) lives in a ranked pack that defends a
territory and hunts ungulates together. A breeding pair leads; helpers
feed pups at a den. Howls keep the group in contact across forest and
tundra. After near-extirpation in much of the contiguous United States,
reintroductions (notably Yellowstone) showed how a large canid reshapes
elk browsing and riparian vegetation.
